flags: Cached Transportation Cabinet inventory establishes the designation, date and corridor but supplies no scenic rationale, builders, campaign history, road geometry or drive time. Local spring and park history provides context rather than an unsupported road-construction narrative.

Driving order follows increasing strip-map miles, opposite the inventory’s written direction: Commissary Corner/Belleview, Rabbit Hash, Big Bone, Beaverlick. Road-to-town geography is supported by cache; exact turn-by-turn continuity is not independently mapped here.

Dropped current tagline’s assertion that mammoths came and got stuck: the cache qualifies their attraction to salt as a belief and speaks of trapped animals generally. Removed “always” from the springs claim. Other current factual claims have cache support.

Natural history and Lewis/Clark account have only Wikipedia support in the cache; no park-manager or primary historical page is saved. The cached park article contains a questionable 1926 Clark memorial account, not used. Current visitor hours and access conditions are not asserted.

Store is explicitly a 2017 rebuilding using surviving material, not an intact original. No dog is identified as the current mayor. Current story and moments have no motifs fields; story motifs initialized empty.
